cross_doubts.why: Rules out --out/--tag correctly and flags laundering, but never names the ACTUAL cause of the 0.000->1.000 flip: the regenerated dataset. RETRIEVAL is TF-IDF over the dataset; dataset is gitignored and regenerated on clean clone -> index over different content -> different retrieval. Real variable = dataset, not script. Same root cause as release cluster. If fix only relabels without pinning/regenerating dataset deterministically, STAT-03 'closes' but non-reproducible TF-IDF remains.

A/B isolates SCRIPT drift (random.seed) but holds the (regenerated) dataset constant, so it does NOT isolate dataset non-reproducibility. Claim false for TWO independent reasons: (a) script drift (confirmed), (b) dataset gitignored+regenerated (not bit-identical). Fixing (a) does not fix (b). Same root cause as STAT-03 and R4-01.
